description:
Built for rugged gravel adventures, the Mercian Pro Lugless 44 delivers unmatched durability and smooth handling. Its lugless double-oversized steel tubing frame ensures strength, responsive control, comfort, and versatility on challenging terrains. Experience precision and confidence wherever the gravel takes you.

Made with Reynolds 853 Pro Team double-oversized double butted steel tubing, the frame is built with a 44mm head tube, bolt through dropouts for disc brakes and a Deda Gera EDG fork, with the T47 bottom bracket allowing for full internal brake hose routing. The Lugless 44 allows for up to 47mm tyres.

Built by hand in our Derby workshop, the Lugless 44 is available as frame-only or fully assembled: choose one of our three assembly packages – or we can help you build up the assembly to your own specification.

frame.material_detail: Reynolds 853 Pro Team Double-Oversized Double-Butted Steel
